summary: Read a pair of binary trees. Each node stores an integer, and an absent child belongs to the shape. Decide whether the two trees agree completely. At every position both sides have a node or both sides are empty, and paired nodes must store one identical integer. A single difference in shape, or any mismatch among the integers, means they disagree. Two empty trees agree. Write the conclusion as yes or no.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
